title: dactylorhiza × ornonensis
intro: Dactylorhiza × ornonensis, commonly known as the Ornon orchid, is a rare, hybrid orchid species resulting from the cross between Dactylorhiza fuchsii and Dactylorhiza maculata. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, digestive issues, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza × ornonensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which may contribute to its medicinal properties. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
